artDirection.medium: Project-local vector diagrams and typographic system maps.
artDirection.palette: Deep ink background, electric cyan for algorithms, violet for models, warm amber for systems, and soft white labels.
artDirection.lighting: Restrained luminous edges with one active focal layer at a time.
artDirection.texture: Clean matte fields with a subtle project-authored grid; no photographic media.
artDirection.compositionGrammar: A persistent three-layer vertical stack evolves from separate concepts into one connected operating system.
artDirection.motionLanguage: Frame-driven reveals, causal connectors, parameter pulses, and deliberate layer handoffs.
artDirection.typography: Large concise Chinese concept labels; narration captions remain exclusively top-level.

continuityRules: Keep cyan, violet, and amber mapped to algorithm, model, and AI system throughout.
Preserve the same three-layer spatial order whenever multiple concepts appear together.
End each Scene with a visual state that the next Scene can inherit without moving spoken frames.
forbiddenTreatments: No remote assets, directory scanning, CSS animation, CSS transition, or historical Scene imitation.
Do not render narration captions or duplicate full narration text inside Scene visuals.
Do not place semantic content outside the assignment-provided guarded content frame.
